title: Jollypoldy the rixdix doldy
html_source: This is a common form of a rhyming play on names that a child might make, with a similar structure to the line “Stephen the Reephen, the Rix-Dix Deephen” from Joyce’s Stephen Hero. A “doldy” is a stupid or impotent person.
